**Cloud Agent Validation Tools** (ON by default at `Settings -> Copilot -> Cloud agent -> Validation tools`) automatically check code generated by [[Copilot Cloud Agent]] and self-fix detected issues before opening a pull request.

## Four Built-in Validations (No GHAS License Required)

| Validation Tool | What It Verifies |
| --- | --- |
| **CodeQL Code scanning** | SQL injection, XSS, and unsafe API vulnerabilities |
| **Copilot Code Review** | Logic bugs, regressions, and unnecessary complexity |
| **Secret Scanning** | Hardcoded API keys, tokens, and credentials |
| **Dependency Vulnerability Checks** | Newly added packages checked against the GitHub Advisory Database |

## Partner SDK Coverage

- When [[Partner Agents]] (`OpenAI Codex SDK` or `Claude Agent SDK`) run inside Cloud Agent, all four validation tools enforce the exact same pre-PR safety net for free.
